## Why This Is Asked
Tests the ability to compose a practical, end‑to‑end CI/CD flow for a Python service: containerization, multi-environment deployment, feature flags, secret management, manual gates, health validation, and observability.

## Key Concepts
- Azure DevOps YAML pipelines and stages
- Docker build and push to Azure Container Registry (ACR)
- Deployment slots for staging and prod
- Azure App Configuration per environment for feature flags
- Azure Key Vault integration for test secrets
- Manual approvals and post‑deploy health checks
- Automatic rollback and Log Analytics auditing

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger:
  branches:
    include:
      - main
pool:
  vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
variables:
  imageName: 'python-microservice'
  registry: 'myacr.azurecr.io'
stages:
- stage: BuildTest
  jobs:
  - job: Build
    steps:
    - checkout: self
    - task: UsePythonVersion@0
      inputs: { versionSpec: '3.x' }
    - script: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt
      displayName: 'Install dependencies'
    - script: |
        pytest
      displayName: 'Run tests'
    - script: |
        ruff . --select M,R
      displayName: 'Lint'
    - task: Docker@2
      inputs:
        command: buildAndPush
        containerregistry: '$(registry)'
        repository: '$(imageName)'
        Dockerfile: '**/Dockerfile'
        tags: '$(Build.BuildId)'
- stage: DeployStaging
  dependsOn: BuildTest
  jobs:
  - deployment: DeployStg
    environment: 'staging'
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
          - script: |
              echo Deploying to staging slot
            displayName: 'Deploy to staging'
          - task: AzureWebAppContainer@1
            inputs:
              appName: 'my-app-staging'
              images: '$(registry)/$(imageName):$(Build.BuildId)'
- stage: ProdGate
  dependsOn: DeployStaging
  jobs:
  - job: ApproveProd
    steps:
    - task: ManualValidation@0
      inputs:
        notifyUsers: '['user@domain.com']'
        timeout: '0:30:00'
        title: 'Approve prod deployment'
        instructions: 'Review health and metrics before production deployment'
- stage: DeployProd
  dependsOn: ProdGate
  jobs:
  - deployment: DeployProd
    environment: 'production'
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
          - script: |
              echo Deploying to production slot
            displayName: 'Deploy to prod'
          - task: AzureWebAppContainer@1
            inputs:
              appName: 'my-app-production'
              images: '$(registry)/$(imageName):$(Build.BuildId)'
          - script: |
              curl -sSf http://my-app-production/health
            displayName: 'Post-deploy health check'
          - powershell: |
              $healthy = (Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://my-app-production/health' -UseBasicParsing).StatusCode -eq 200
              if (-not $healthy) { throw 'Health check failed' }
            displayName: 'Health verification'
- stage: RollbackIfNeeded
  dependsOn: DeployProd
  condition: failed()
  jobs:
  - job: Rollback
    steps:
    - script: |
        echo Rolling back to previous prod image
      displayName: 'Rollback'
```

## Why This Is Asked
This question tests the ability to design multi-cluster deployment pipelines in Azure DevOps, combining GitOps (Flux) and traditional Helm approaches. It evaluates understanding of per-cluster configuration management, secrets handling, progressive delivery strategies, and observability—all critical skills for production-grade Kubernetes deployments.

## Key Concepts
- Azure DevOps YAML templates with conditional stages and jobs
- Flux GitOps vs Helm deployments in AKS clusters
- Azure App Configuration for feature flags per cluster
- Azure Key Vault secrets integration
- Canary deployments and health checks
- Azure Policy gates and automatic rollback strategies
- Azure Monitor Logs for pipeline observability

## Code Example
```yaml
# azure-pipelines.yml
trigger:
  - main

resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: templates
      type: git
      name: Shared/PipelineTemplates

parameters:
  - name: environments
    type: object
    default:
      - name: dev
        cluster: dev-aks-eastus
        clusterType: flux
      - name: staging
        cluster: staging-aks-eastus
        clusterType: helm
      - name: prod
        cluster: prod-aks-westeu
        clusterType: helm

stages:
  - stage: Build
    jobs:
      - job: BuildAndPush
        steps:
          - task: Docker@2
            displayName: Build and push container
            inputs:
              containerRegistry: 'acrConnection'
              repository: 'myapp'
              tag: '$(Build.BuildId)'

  - stage: Deploy_Dev
    dependsOn: Build
    jobs:
      - template: deploy-aks.yml@templates
        parameters:
          environment: dev
          clusterName: dev-aks-eastus
          clusterType: flux
          appConfigName: app-config-dev
          keyVaultName: kv-dev-eastus

  - stage: Deploy_Staging
    dependsOn: Deploy_Dev
    jobs:
      - template: deploy-aks.yml@templates
        parameters:
          environment: staging
          clusterName: staging-aks-eastus
          clusterType: helm
          appConfigName: app-config-staging
          keyVaultName: kv-staging-eastus
      - job: CanaryHealthCheck
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'aksConnection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az aks command invoke \
                  --name staging-aks-eastus \
                  --resource-group rg-staging \
                  --command "kubectl rollout status deployment/myapp"

  - stage: Deploy_Prod
    dependsOn: Deploy_Staging
    jobs:
      - deployment: DeployProd
        environment: 'prod'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - template: deploy-aks.yml@templates
                  parameters:
                    environment: prod
                    clusterName: prod-aks-westeu
                    clusterType: helm
                    appConfigName: app-config-prod
                    keyVaultName: kv-prod-westeu
      - job: ProdGate
        dependsOn: DeployProd
        steps:
          - task: AzurePolicy@0
            displayName: Check production policy compliance
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'aksConnection'
              policyDefinition: 'prod-aks-policy'
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: Verify health and rollback if failed
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'aksConnection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                HEALTH=$(curl -s http://myapp.prod.internal/health)
                if [ "$HEALTH" != "healthy" ]; then
                  echo "##vso[task.logissue type=error]Health check failed"
                  echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=ROLLBACK;isOutput=true]true"
                  exit 1
                fi

  - stage: Monitor
    dependsOn:
      - Deploy_Dev
      - Deploy_Staging
      - Deploy_Prod
    jobs:
      - job: LogToMonitor
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: Log deployment results to Azure Monitor
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'monitorConnection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor app-insights trace show \
                  --app myapp-insights \
                  --analytics "deployment | where timestamp > ago(1h)"
```

parameters:
  - name: environment
    type: string
  - name: clusterName
    type: string
  - name: clusterType
    type: string
  - name: appConfigName
    type: string
  - name: keyVaultName
    type: string

steps:
  - task: AzureCLI@2
    displayName: 'Fetch App Configuration flags for ${{ parameters.environment }}'
    inputs:
      azureSubscription: 'aksConnection'
      scriptType: 'bash'
      scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
      inlineScript: |
        az appconfig kv export \
          --name ${{ parameters.appConfigName }} \
          --format json \
          --output-file config.json

  - task: AzureCLI@2
    displayName: 'Fetch Key Vault secrets for ${{ parameters.environment }}'
    inputs:
      azureSubscription: 'aksConnection'
      scriptType: 'bash'
      scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
      inlineScript: |
        az keyvault secret list \
          --vault-name ${{ parameters.keyVaultName }} \
          --query '[].name' \
          -o tsv

  - task: HelmDeploy@0
    displayName: 'Deploy to ${{ parameters.clusterName }}'
    condition: eq('${{ parameters.clusterType }}', 'helm')
    inputs:
      connectionType: 'Azure Resource Manager'
      azureSubscription: 'aksConnection'
      azureResourceGroup: 'rg-aks'
      kubernetesCluster: '${{ parameters.clusterName }}'
      namespace: '${{ parameters.environment }}'
      command: 'upgrade --install'
      chartType: 'FilePath'
      chartPath: 'charts/myapp'
      valueFile: 'charts/myapp/values-${{ parameters.environment }}.yaml'

  - task: AzureCLI@2
    displayName: 'Deploy via Flux for GitOps cluster'
    condition: eq('${{ parameters.clusterType }}', 'flux')
    inputs:
      azureSubscription: 'aksConnection'
      scriptType: 'bash'
      scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
      inlineScript: |
        az aks get-credentials --name ${{ parameters.clusterName }} --resource-group rg-aks
        flux install
        flux create source git myapp \
          --url=https://github.com/org/repo \
          --branch=main
        flux create kustomization myapp \
          --source=myapp \
          --path=clusters/${{ parameters.environment }}

## Why This Is Asked
Assesses concrete integration of GitOps (ArgoCD) inside Azure DevOps pipelines, ephemeral environments, cost governance, secret management, and observability at scale.

## Key Concepts
- GitOps with ArgoCD in Azure DevOps pipelines
- Ephemeral AKS namespaces per PR
- Secrets from Azure Key Vault per environment
- Feature flags via Azure App Configuration
- Azure Cost Management budgets as gate before deploy
- Post-deployment health checks and synthetic tests
- Automatic teardown on PR close or after grace period
- End-to-end logging in Azure Monitor

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger: none
pr:
  branches:
    include:
    - main

variables:
  - group: 'shared-infrastructure'
  - name: kubernetesNamespace
    value: 'pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  - name: gitopsRepo
    value: 'https://github.com/contoso/app-config'
  - name: argoApp
    value: 'pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'

stages:
- stage: Provision
  displayName: 'Provision Ephemeral Environment'
  jobs:
  - job: CreateNamespace
    displayName: 'Create AKS Namespace'
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Create Kubernetes Namespace'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          kubectl create namespace $(kubernetesNamespace) --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
          kubectl label namespace $(kubernetesNamespace) environment=ephemeral pr-id=$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)

- stage: CostGate
  displayName: 'Cost Budget Validation'
  dependsOn: Provision
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - job: CheckBudget
    displayName: 'Validate Cost Budget'
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Check Cost Management Budget'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          currentSpend=$(az costmanagement query --scope "/subscriptions/$(subscriptionId)" --type "ActualCost" --timeframe "MonthToDate" --query "[0].Amount" -o tsv)
          budgetLimit=$(az consumption budget list --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --query "[0].amount" -o tsv)
          if (( $(echo "$currentSpend >= $budgetLimit" | bc -l) )); then
            echo "Cost budget exceeded: $currentSpend >= $budgetLimit"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Cost budget check passed: $currentSpend < $budgetLimit"

- stage: Deploy
  displayName: 'Deploy via ArgoCD'
  dependsOn: CostGate
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - job: ArgoCDDeploy
    displayName: 'Deploy Application'
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Create ArgoCD Application'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
          apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
          kind: Application
          metadata:
            name: $(argoApp)
            namespace: argocd
          spec:
            project: ephemeral
            source:
              repoURL: $(gitopsRepo)
              targetRevision: HEAD
              path: environments/$(kubernetesNamespace)
              helm:
                values: |
                  namespace: $(kubernetesNamespace)
                  secrets:
                    keyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
                    secretNames: ["app-db-connection", "app-api-key"]
                  featureFlags:
                    appConfigurationName: $(appConfigurationName)
                    filter: "env=$(kubernetesNamespace)"
            destination:
              server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
              namespace: $(kubernetesNamespace)
            syncPolicy:
              automated:
                prune: true
                selfHeal: true
              syncOptions:
                - CreateNamespace=false
                - PrunePropagationPolicy=foreground
          EOF

    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Wait for ArgoCD Sync'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          timeout=600
          interval=10
          elapsed=0
          while [ $elapsed -lt $timeout ]; do
            status=$(kubectl get application $(argoApp) -n argocd -o jsonpath='{.status.health.status}')
            if [ "$status" = "Healthy" ]; then
              echo "Application deployed successfully"
              break
            fi
            echo "Waiting for deployment... ($elapsed/$timeout seconds)"
            sleep $interval
            elapsed=$((elapsed + interval))
          done
          if [ $elapsed -ge $timeout ]; then
            echo "Deployment timeout reached"
            exit 1
          fi

- stage: Validate
  displayName: 'Post-Deployment Validation'
  dependsOn: Deploy
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - job: HealthChecks
    displayName: 'Run Health Checks'
    steps:
    - task: Bash@3
      displayName: 'Application Health Check'
      inputs:
        targetType: 'inline'
        script: |
          echo "Running health checks for $(kubernetesNamespace)..."
          # Add your health check commands here
          # Example: curl -f http://service-url/health

    - job: SyntheticTests
      displayName: 'Run Synthetic Tests'
      dependsOn: HealthChecks
      steps:
      - task: Bash@3
        displayName: 'Execute Synthetic Tests'
        inputs:
          targetType: 'inline'
          script: |
            echo "Running synthetic tests..."
            # Add your synthetic test commands here
            # Example: npm run test:synthetic

- stage: Teardown
  displayName: 'Teardown Environment'
  dependsOn: Validate
  condition: always()
  jobs:
  - job: Cleanup
    displayName: 'Clean Resources'
    timeoutInMinutes: 30
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Remove ArgoCD Application'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          kubectl delete application $(argoApp) -n argocd --ignore-not-found=true

    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Remove Namespace'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          kubectl delete namespace $(kubernetesNamespace) --ignore-not-found=true
          echo "Namespace $(kubernetesNamespace) cleaned up successfully"

- stage: AutoTeardown
  displayName: 'Scheduled Teardown (48 hours)'
  condition: and(always(), eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main'))
  jobs:
  - job: DelayedCleanup
    displayName: 'Wait and Cleanup'
    timeoutInMinutes: 2880  # 48 hours
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Timeout Cleanup'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          echo "48-hour timeout reached, cleaning up environment"
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          kubectl delete namespace $(kubernetesNamespace) --ignore-not-found=true
          kubectl delete application $(argoApp) -n argocd --ignore-not-found=true
```

## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates understanding of enterprise CI/CD practices with Azure DevOps, including infrastructure-as-code validation, secret management, feature flag implementation, blue-green deployments, approval gates, and monitoring integration.

## Key Concepts
- **ARM Template Validation**: Using arm-ttk to validate Azure Resource Manager templates before deployment
- **Secret Management**: Securely retrieving credentials from Azure Key Vault
- **Feature Flags**: Using Azure App Configuration for per-environment configuration
- **Staging Deployments**: Deploying to a staging slot for validation before production
- **Manual Gate**: Requiring manual approval before production deployment
- **Drift Detection**: Checking for configuration drift and logging to Log Analytics

## Code Example
```yaml
# Azure DevOps YAML Pipeline demonstrating the complete workflow
trigger: main

variables:
  azureServiceConnection: 'azure-sp'
  keyVaultName: 'prod-keyvault'
  appConfigName: 'prod-appconfig'
  appServiceName: 'linux-app-service'
  resourceGroup: 'prod-rg'
  logWorkspace: 'log-analytics-workspace'

stages:
  - stage: Validate
    jobs:
      - job: Validate_ARM
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az group deployment validate \
                  --resource-group $(resourceGroup) \
                  --template-file arm/template.json

      - job: Run_Unit_Tests
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: Python@1
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '3.10'
          - script: pip install pytest
            displayName: 'Install pytest'
          - script: pytest tests/
            displayName: 'Run unit tests'

  - stage: Deploy_Staging
    dependsOn: Validate
    jobs:
      - deployment: Deploy_Staging_Slot
        environment: 'staging'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureKeyVault@2
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
                    SecretsFilter: '*'

                - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    AppConfigurationEndpoint: 'https://$(appConfigName).azconfig.io'
                    KeyValueFilters: 'Environment=Staging'

                - task: AzureResourceGroupDeployment@3
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    resourceGroupName: $(resourceGroup)
                    location: 'eastus'
                    templateFile: 'arm/template.json'
                    parametersFile: 'arm/parameters.staging.json'

                - task: AzureWebApp@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    appType: 'webAppLinux'
                    appName: $(appServiceName)
                    deployToSlotOrASE: true
                    slotName: 'staging'

  - stage: Production_Approval
    dependsOn: Deploy_Staging
    jobs:
      - job: Wait_For_Approval
        pool:
          server: true
        steps:
          - task: ManualValidation@0
            timeoutInMinutes: 4320
            inputs:
              notifyUsers: '$(notifyEmail)'
              instructions: 'Please validate staging deployment and approve for production'
              onTimeout: 'reject'

  - stage: Deploy_Production
    dependsOn: Production_Approval
    condition: succeeded()
    jobs:
      - deployment: Deploy_Production
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureWebApp@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    appType: 'webAppLinux'
                    appName: $(appServiceName)
                    deployToSlotOrASE: true
                    slotName: 'staging'
                    action: 'Swap Slots'

                - task: AzureCLI@2
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    scriptType: 'bash'
                    scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
                    inlineScript: |
                      az monitor app-insights show \
                        --app $(appServiceName) \
                        --resource-group $(resourceGroup) \
                        --query properties.InstrumentationKey

                - task: AzureCLI@2
                  displayName: 'Log drift check to Log Analytics'
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    scriptType: 'bash'
                    scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
                    inlineScript: |
                      az monitor log-analytics query \
                        --workspace $(logWorkspace) \
                        --query "Cupertino | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)"
```

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger:
  - main

variables:
  azureServiceConnection: 'azure-sp'
  functionAppName: 'my-function-app'
  appConfigName: 'my-app-config'
  keyVaultName: 'my-key-vault'

stages:
  - stage: Build
    jobs:
      - job: Build
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: NodeTool@0
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '18.x'
          - script: npm install
          - script: npm run build
          - publish: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/dist
            artifact: drop

  - stage: Test_Audit
    dependsOn: Build
    jobs:
      - job: Test_and_Lint
        steps:
          - task: NodeTool@0
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '18.x'
          - script: npm install
          - script: npm run lint
          - script: npm test
      - job: Security_Audit
        steps:
          - task: NodeTool@0
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '18.x'
          - script: npm install
          - script: npm audit --audit-level=moderate

  - stage: Deploy_Staging
    dependsOn: Test_Audit
    variables:
      environment: 'staging'
    jobs:
      - deployment: DeployToStaging
        environment: 'staging'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureKeyVault@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
                    SecretsFilter: '*'
                - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    AppConfigurationEndpoint: 'https://$(appConfigName).azconfig.io'
                    labels: 'staging'
                - task: AzureFunctionApp@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    appType: 'functionApp'
                    appName: $(functionAppName)
                    deploySlot: true
                    slotName: 'staging'
                    package: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/dist/*.zip'

  - stage: Load_Test
    dependsOn: Deploy_Staging
    jobs:
      - job: Run_k6
        steps:
          - task: k6LoadTest@1
            inputs:
              filePath: 'tests/load-test.js'
             vus: '50'
              duration: '30s'
              threshold: 'p95=1200,error_rate=1'

  - stage: Promote_or_Rollback
    dependsOn: Load_Test
    jobs:
      - job: Check_conditions
        steps:
          - task: PowerShell@2
            inputs:
              targetType: 'inline'
              script: |
                $metrics = @{
                  p95Latency = 1150
                  errorRate = 0.5
                }
                if ($metrics.p95Latency -lt 1200 -and $metrics.errorRate -lt 1) {
                  Write-Host "Promoting to production"
                } else {
                  Write-Host "##vso[task.logissue type=error]Promote conditions not met"
                  exit 1
                }
      - job: Promote_to_Production
        dependsOn: Check_conditions
        condition: succeeded()
        steps:
          - task: AzureFunctionApp@1
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              appType: 'functionApp'
              appName: $(functionAppName)
              deploySlot: true
              slotName: 'staging'
              swapWithProduction: true
      - job: Rollback_on_Failure
        dependsOn: Check_conditions
        condition: failed()
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az functionApp deployment slot swap \
                  --resource-group my-rg \
                  --name $(functionAppName) \
                  --slot staging \
                  --target-slot production
          - task: AzureMonitor@1
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              alertsToSearch: 'all'
              insightsToSearch: 'all'
```
